The diagram shows the graph of the probability density function, $\text{f}$, of a random variable $X$ which takes values between 0 and $a$ only. It is given that $\text{P}(X < 1) = 0.25$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Find, in any order,

**(a)** $\text{P}(X < 2)$,

**(b)** the value of $a$,

**(c)** $\text{f}(x)$.
